### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of sauced chicken pieces, a rice-and-vegetable mixture that may contain egg, and two small pieces of cheese-and-tomato pizza. Identification is somewhat uncertain because of the lighting.

### 2 — Vessel
A round dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The chicken’s visible sauce is included in its estimate; pizza toppings are included with the pizza. No separate quantity of oil can be reliably distinguished.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Sauced chicken pieces | 18% | 96 cm² × 1.6 cm = 154 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 146 g | 210 | 307 kcal |
| Rice, vegetable, and possible egg mixture | 30% | 159 cm² × 1.6 cm = 254 ml | 0.8 g/ml | 203 g | 160 | 325 kcal |
| Cheese-and-tomato pizza pieces | 24% | 127 cm² × 1.0 cm = 127 ml | 0.9 g/ml | 114 g | 270 | 308 kcal |

**Area check:** 18% + 30% + 24% = **72% coverage**, consistent with the visible uncovered rim.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **463 g and approximately 940 kcal**. This is plausible for a mostly covered dinner plate containing chicken, a substantial mixed-rice portion, and two small pizza pieces. Chicken bones, if present, and uncertainty about the central mixture could noticeably affect the estimate.
